controlPlane: GitHub Actions runner and CI evidence
architecture.ownershipBoundary: GitHub is source authority; Cloudflare is runtime/deployment authority. A declared integration is not evidence that a build target or runtime binding is configured.

runtime.healthCurrentSemantics: HTTP 200 plain text ok; liveness only, not dependency readiness
runtime.secretPolicy: Never return secret values. Expose only configured booleans; fail readiness for required production secrets only after environment-specific requirements are explicitly declared.
runtime.telemetryPolicy: Structured records include timestamp, runtime version, environment, request/correlation ID when available, route class, status, duration, and outcome. Never log secrets, credentials, raw authorization headers, or unnecessary personal data.
runtime.versioningPolicy: Existing endpoint shapes are compatibility contracts. Any breaking response change requires a versioned endpoint or explicit schema-version bump and regression tests.

acceptancePredicate: runner_id is numeric and greater than zero
runner_name is populated and matches the intended runner
job is assigned to that runner
a sentinel step executes and records the expected commit SHA
validator result is recorded with PASS/FAIL and commit SHA
a downloadable artifact is present and its digest is recorded
g02.failureSemantics: No runner assignment, empty jobs/steps, missing logs, or missing artifact means FAIL or BLOCKED, never PASS.
g02.retryPolicy: Do not launch retry storms. After runner/dispatch configuration changes, run one controlled diagnostic workflow and inspect its run ID, jobs, runner identity, steps, logs, and artifacts.

releaseGates.passRule: PASS requires all gate-specific predicates and independently inspectable evidence bound to the tested commit SHA.
releaseGates.failRule: FAIL means a tested predicate failed or a contradiction was observed.
releaseGates.blockedRule: BLOCKED means a prerequisite or trustworthy evidence is absent; it must not be represented as PASS.
releaseGates.promotionRule: No release gate promotion, merge, deployment, activation, or traffic mutation while a required gate is FAIL or BLOCKED.

preDeployValidationMustFailOn: preview config contains production route patterns
production config differs unexpectedly from reviewed baseline

implementation.rollback: Revert only commits on this isolated branch; do not alter production configuration. Stop if a proposed diff changes production routes, Worker identity, production secrets, DNS, deployment, or release authorization.
